The reaction mixture was incubated for 60 min at 27Â° C. using 50 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.4) buffer containing 4 mM CaCl2 and 0.1% ascorbic acid, and harvested through filtermate A glass fiber filter (Wallac, Finland) presoaked in 0.5% polyethyleneimine (PEI) by microbeta filtermate-96 harvester (PerkinElmer) to terminate the reaction, and then washed with ice cold 50 mM Tris-HCl buffer solution (pH 7.4).
